title: Geometric Collapse in the Toroidal Six-Vertex Model
exact_target: Test the proposed six-vertex phase transition in which emergent torus geometry collapses at a critical modulus with nonzero imaginary part.

status_qualification: The comparison comes from a dimer model where the torus angle collapses as the imaginary part tends to zero. The six-vertex conjecture deliberately predicts different behavior with nonzero critical imaginary part; it cannot be replaced by the usual cusp degeneration. The exact geometric-collapse observable remains part of the source construction.
